headline: Antonelli comes out on top after 5 lead changes in Miami Gardens
standfirst: Kimi Antonelli won the Miami Grand Prix for Mercedes, finishing 3.264s ahead of Lando Norris, with Oscar Piastri completing the podium after 57 laps of Miami.

sections.title: The start
sections.body: Kimi Antonelli lined up first on the grid. Leclerc got the better launch and led the field across the line at the end of the opening lap. The biggest winner of the opening lap was Albon, up 5 places to 10th.

sections.title: How it unfolded
sections.body: The lead changed hands 5 times. Laps led: Antonelli (30), Norris (15), Leclerc (11) and Verstappen (1). Antonelli took the lead for good on lap 29. The race was neutralised by 1 safety car period (lap 6–11).

sections.title: Strategy
sections.body: Antonelli made 1 stop, running medium → hard tyres. The field made 22 pit stops in total; the quickest stationary time was 2.2s for Antonelli on lap 26. 10 of the top 10 finishers got home with one stop or fewer.

sections.title: Movers
sections.body: Gabriel Bortoleto made up the most ground, climbing 9 places from 21st to 12th. Leclerc went the other way, slipping from 3rd to 8th. Timing recorded 267 on-track position changes, 27 of them by Verstappen.

sections.title: Retirements
sections.body: Hadjar (lap 5), Gasly (lap 5), Hulkenberg (lap 8) and Lawson (lap 7) failed to finish.

sections.title: Conditions and pace
sections.body: It stayed dry throughout. Track temperature ranged from 35°C to 42°C, with air at 27–28°C. Lando Norris set the fastest lap, a 1:31.869 on lap 35.
